decisions.title: BF is BrokerFlow, and it is a Studio module
decisions.decision: BF is not a separate product with its own customers. It is 'Full BrokerFlow', one of the 14 wired modules on the Studio shelf.
decisions.why: Found by reading fmtventures/Financial-tool: modules/brokerflow/ exists, and studio/registry.js lists it as wired with cma-pei and listing-writer as its skills.

decisions.title: The website builder is the Studio's Website module
decisions.decision: The 'website builder' is the wired `website` module, which exports a hostable marketing page.
decisions.why: studio/registry.js lists it first, wired, with its idea credited to PEIFOTOSHOP.

decisions.title: The module attachment mechanism already exists
decisions.decision: No new mechanism needs designing. The Builder already composes any combination of shelf modules into a branded per-client portal, and pricing is by module count (Starter/Pro/Platform), not per-module add-ons.
decisions.why: This was the original question — how the website builder could attach to a tool like BF. Both are already modules on one shelf.

decisions.title: This board syncs modules, never copies them
decisions.decision: The module list is generated from studio/registry.js by sync-modules.mjs. Studio modules are not edited here.
decisions.why: A hand-maintained second copy would drift on the next module added — the exact complaint the Studio was built to answer.

decisions.title: Effort stays blank until it is measured
decisions.decision: Hours and tokens are null wherever they were never tracked. No estimates, no back-filled guesses.
decisions.why: A fabricated number becomes the basis for a real prioritisation call. There is also no API that can recover spend from the earlier chats.

decisions.title: Supabase for the Studio's Phase 2, not a low-code platform
decisions.decision: Proposed: use Supabase as the Studio backend rather than rebuilding on Bubble, WeWeb or Retool.
decisions.why: It is already in Sidelio's stack, keeps the static-site architecture the Studio's value rests on, and avoids a per-seat platform cost underneath a $49/mo product. One backend across both platforms instead of two.

decisions.title: Move this dashboard off the public repo
decisions.decision: Proposed: relocate dashboard/ from the public Exuma2 repo into a private one.
decisions.why: registry.json is currently world-readable, including pricing and strategic notes.

decisions.title: The portfolio is bigger than the eight GitHub repos — real client work exists
decisions.decision: A local scan found projects never on GitHub: a Rally monorepo (likely next-gen Sidelio), four external client websites (Starliner, Saggo, PEI Video, Service RH), and A Lot o Gelato. Several client repos have no GitHub remote and are unbacked up.
decisions.why: Answers the highest-value open question — yes, the website capability is doing paid external work — and reveals that the real Sidelio app and several client sites live only on local disk and an external drive.

decisions.title: Claire 80 is a birthday presentation, not a product
decisions.decision: Claire 80 is "Claire — 80 ans d'amour", an 80th-birthday presentation on the SATECHI drive. Finished, one-off, kept on the board only to close the question.
decisions.why: It was an unknown across earlier sessions; the scan found it.

sessions.summary: Built the Build Board: registry model, views, module matrix, local server with save-to-file, the module sync from The Ship, and the Now/Decisions workbench. Read three repos and corrected the seeded data — BF turned out to be BrokerFlow.
